title: Clue about Chen Nian
next_chapter_hook: When that string of runes slowly manifested in the Void, Chen Ji knew the final door to his sister had opened for him—but the path beyond that door, should he tread it alone, or bring along those who might stab him in the back?

text.content: Ye Qing's words fell like cold ice to the ground, and everyone present felt that chilling killing intent. Her form was barely visible within the demonic aura, purple-black patterns spreading along her arms—this was the precursor to 'Demonic Path Miasma'—once unleashed, perception within a hundred zhang would be completely disrupted. The Holy Sect disciple's faces instantly turned ugly; they hadn't expected this Demonic Path Saintess to openly turn hostile over a Servant Disciple.

dialogue.content: Step aside, or die.

text.content: Chen Ji stood behind Ye Qing, his expression still calm as still water, as if the confrontation before him had nothing to do with him. Only he knew that his heart, dormant for years, was pounding violently. The Tianji Record Fragment in his arms grew slightly warm, a familiar power awakening—this was the precursor of foresight about to trigger. His pupils reflected the Holy Sect disciple's form, but in his heart he was rapidly calculating: how many people were here? Could Ye Qing suppress them? If he revealed the Tianji Record, what consequences would follow?

dialogue.content: (Ye Qing, thank you. But today's matter need not burden her with too much risk.)

text.content: He stepped forward, positioning himself before Ye Qing. This action left everyone present stunned—a Foundation Building Initial Stage废物, daring to step before the Demonic Path Saintess? The leading Holy Sect disciple sneered: 'What, a废物 trying to play hero? You think because the Saintess is protecting you, you don't know your own weight?' His words were full of contempt, as if looking at an overreaching ant.

dialogue.content: I indeed don't know my own weight.

Chen Ji's voice was terrifyingly calm, 'But I know you cannot take me today.' His gaze swept across the four opponents, as if looking at four corpses, 'And I also know your true purpose for coming here—it's not me at all.'

text.content: This sentence was like a precise blade stabbing into their hearts. The Holy Sect disciple's smile froze on their faces, a flash of astonishment in their eyes. They had indeed come for something else—recently there had been strange movements in the depths of the secret realm, seemingly related to the 'Heavenly Fate Lock Key.' But they had never revealed this matter—how could this废物 know? Just as doubt filled them, the Tianji Record Fragment in Chen Ji's arms suddenly burst forth with dazzling golden light.

choice.prompt: The Tianji Record's foresight suddenly triggered—at this life-or-death moment, Chen Ji must make a choice.

choices.text: Proactively guide the direction of foresight.
choices.description: Use the Tianji Record to peer into the Holy Sect's true purpose, displaying leverage before the enemy.
choices.visible_cost: Consume 5 points of Heavenly Fate Value.
choices.visible_reward: Obtain key intelligence on the Holy Sect, grasp the initiative in dialogue.
choices.risk_hint: Revealing the Tianji Record may invite greater covetousness.

text.content: Golden light enveloped Chen Ji's vision, the surrounding clamor vanishing instantly. He felt his consciousness being pulled by a powerful force, crossing the barriers of time and space—this time, he proactively directed his gaze toward the direction from which the Holy Sect disciples had come.

choices.description: Forcefully interrupt the Tianji Record's triggering, respond to the current crisis in a mortal manner.
choices.visible_cost: Endure one round of the opponent's attack.
choices.visible_reward: Preserve hidden cards, let Ye Qing resolve the dispute.
choices.risk_hint: May bring trouble to Ye Qing, and miss key intelligence.

text.content: Chen Ji fiercely bit his tongue, the sharp pain instantly clearing his consciousness. The Tianji Record's light abruptly dimmed, but the impulse of foresight still surged within him, like a forcibly suppressed volcano. He raised his head, slightly shaking it at Ye Qing, signaling her to strike first. Preserving hidden cards—that is the long-term strategy.

choices.text: Kill with a borrowed knife, drive the tiger to swallow the wolf.
choices.description: Deliberately provoke the Holy Sect disciples, trigger chaos, and reap the benefits as the fisherman who profits from others' conflict.
choices.visible_cost: Requires precise control of the situation
choices.visible_reward: Deplete both sides' strength to gain greater strategic space
choices.risk_hint: If the situation spirals out of control, one might suffer the consequences

text.content: A faint, barely perceptible curve appeared at the corner of Chen Ji's lips. His gaze toward the Holy Sect disciples deepened with meaning: 'I know where the thing you're searching for is.' This sentence was like a stone cast into a still lake, creating waves that shook the heavens. The attention of all four opponents was instantly drawn, and at the same moment, Ye Qing's demonic energy erupted—the timing was perfect.

As the golden light faded, Chen Ji clearly saw the scene within the illusion—a deep and serene underground palace, its walls covered with obscure runes, the air thick with an oppressive, suffocating sensation. At the very center of the palace, a pitch-black chain hung down from the domed ceiling, and at the chain's end was a frail yet familiar figure. Chen Ji's heart contracted sharply. The figure wore a tattered white prisoner's garment, long hair disheveled, face pale as if drained of all blood. Her hands were bound by the chains, dried bloodstains visible at her wrists, feet dangling in midair as if she might fall into the abyss at any moment.

dialogue.content: In the vision, Chen Nian seemed to sense something and slowly raised her head. Her eyes were hollow and lifeless, yet at one moment a faint glimmer of light flickered through—the aura of her younger brother. Her lips moved, uttering a single word silently.

text.content: 'Brother...' Chen Ji read the word. His breath stopped abruptly, his fists unconsciously clenching tight, fingernails digging deep into his palms, blood seeping through his fingers. In this moment, the cracks finally appeared on his perpetually calm face. Rage burned in his chest like wildfire, threatening to burst through the dam of reason. But he did not move. The Tianji Record's illusion continued.

The illusion turned like a shadow puppet show under someone's control. Chen Ji saw the massive stone gate behind Chen Nian, on which four ancient characters were carved—'Heavenly Fate Lock Key'. On each side stood three figures in black robes, their cultivation both above the late Foundation Building stage, their expressions blank as statues. Before the gate was a curtain of light—a certain prohibition. And before the light curtain, an elderly man in purple-gold robes was lecturing a group of Holy Sect disciples.

dialogue.content: 'The Lock Key Hall is the most forbidden of the Holy Sect's forbidden grounds. Anyone who trespasses shall be killed without exception. Remember the passphrase—'Heavenly Fate returns to oblivion, all beings serve as fuel'. Without the passphrase, no one can enter.'

text.content: These words exploded in Chen Ji's mind like thunder. Heavenly Fate Lock Key Hall. Passphrase. Location. All the clues he needed had appeared. The illusion began to fade, and Chen Ji's consciousness was violently pulled back to reality. He opened his eyes to find himself still standing in place, Ye Qing looking at him with concern, while the Holy Sect disciples had already drawn their magical artifacts.

dialogue.content: 'What happened to you? Your complexion looks so terrible.'

text.content: Chen Ji did not answer. His gaze越过夜清，落在圣宗弟子身上，眼中的杀意如同实质。那是一种被压抑太久、终于找到出口的愤怒。他的妹妹，那个他以为已经死去的妹妹，被囚禁在圣宗的地牢里，受尽折磨。而这些人，这些圣宗的走狗，竟然还在追捕他，还在阻止他——不，他不能冲动。他深吸一口气，将那股几乎要冲破胸腔的怒火强行压下。

dialogue.content: Chen Nian, wait for me. Whatever the cost, I will rescue you.

choice.prompt: Chen Ji needs to decide his next move in the confrontation between Ye Qing and the Holy Sect disciples

choices.text: Strike directly to establish威信 through bloodshed
choices.description: Seize the moment when they are stunned, strike first, and kill the leading Holy Sect disciple to intimidate everyone
choices.visible_cost: Reveal part of his strength to attract more enemies to pursue him
choices.visible_reward: Quickly eliminate the threat and gain space for retreat
choices.risk_hint: The Tianqing Sect might go to war with the Holy Sect because of this

text.content: Chen Ji's figure vanished from where he stood. In the next instant, he had already appeared before the leading disciple, the short blade in his hand gleaming with a cold, eerie light. The disciple's pupils contracted sharply, wanting to retreat but already too late—a line of blood blossomed from his throat, like a red plum in bloom.

choices.text: Release demonic mist to cover the retreat
choices.description: Let Ye Qing deploy the demonic path mist, escape in the chaos, and preserve strength
choices.visible_reward: Escape safely and preserve strength to prepare for long-term plans
choices.risk_hint: Might have one's aura remembered by the enemy, inviting future pursuit

text.content: Ye Qing understood, and violet-black mist surged from within her, instantly engulfing everything around. Chen Ji felt a cool power wrap around him—that was the Demonic Path mist isolating all perception. "Go." Ye Qing's voice sounded in his ear, and the next moment, they had vanished into the endless black mist.

choices.text: Exposing intelligence in exchange for a way out
choices.description: Using the Holy Sect confidential intelligence obtained from the prophecy to trade with the other party for escape
choices.visible_cost: Exposing the fact that one knows Holy Sect secrets
choices.visible_reward: Make the other party hesitate to act, gain negotiating leverage
choices.risk_hint: May provoke more frantic pursuit by the Holy Sect

text.content: "Hold." Chen Ji spoke, his voice not loud, yet it made everyone stop their movements. "I know why you've come. The disturbance in the secret realm, the aura of the Heavenly Fate Lock—am I right?" The leading disciple's face changed dramatically; they looked at each other, and finally had to admit that this waste knew far more than they had imagined.

As the mist cleared, Chen Ji found himself in a ruined ancient forest. Ye Qing stood not far away, moonlight filtering through sparse branches and leaves, outlining her silhouette like an immortal in a painting. Her complexion was somewhat pale, clearly the release of the Demonic Path mist had consumed considerable True Qi.

dialogue.content: Just now in the illusion, what did you see?

text.content: Chen Ji was silent for a moment. Over this period, a certain tacit understanding had formed between him and Ye Qing—she wouldn't ask too many questions, but wouldn't hide anything from him either. This wavering trust was what he deliberately maintained—too close would expose himself, too far would lose this important ally.

dialogue.content: I found a person's location.
Important enough to make you lose composure?

text.content: Chen Ji raised his head, moonlight illuminating his eyes, which burned with a never-before-seen light—rage, determination, and a kind of近乎疯狂的执念 (almost mad obsession).

dialogue.content: She is my sister.

text.content: Ye Qing's gaze shifted slightly. She knew Chen Ji had a sister who had been missing for many years, but she had never imagined that the person repeatedly mentioned in his prophecies, yet always with an unreadable face, would suddenly appear now. And imprisoned in the most heavily guarded forbidden grounds of the Holy Sect. She suddenly understood where that almost uncontrollable killing intent in Chen Ji's eyes had come from—that was a brother's guilt and rage toward his sister, suppressed for too long, finally finding an outlet.

dialogue.content: Heavenly Fate Lock Palace. The deepest forbidden grounds of the Holy Sect.

text.content: Ye Qing's voice carried a solemn tone. "Do you know what kind of place that is? There are permanently six Foundation Building late-stage experts rotating guard, with ancient forbidden formations reinforced—even Golden Core stage elders dare not approach lightly. You going alone is suicide." Chen Ji did not speak, just stood there quietly. Ye Qing sighed, "But you won't retreat because of this, will you?"

dialogue.content: I don't know what retreat means.

text.content: Ye Qing looked at the young man before her, suddenly discovering she had never truly seen through him. He was typically cowardly and mediocre, never fighting back even when bullied; he walked on eggshells in the sect, never contending with anyone. But the him standing under the moonlight now had fire in his eyes, a blade in his heart, that sharp edge hidden for too long finally no longer concealed. She suddenly understood why the Holy Sect's prophecy had been broken by him, why the Tianji Record chose him—this was a person with madness carved into his bones, only he knew how to endure, how to wait, how to bare his fangs at the most opportune moment.

choice.prompt: Faced with the difficult task of rescuing Chen Nian, Chen Ji needs to make a strategic choice

choices.description: Taking advantage of the Holy Sect not yet aware, infiltrate the Heavenly Fate Lock Palace at night, relying on the Tianji Record's foresight ability for a slim chance of survival
choices.visible_cost: Consumes a large amount of Heavenly Fate, and the success rate is extremely low
choices.visible_reward: If successful, can rescue Chen Nian before the Holy Sect reacts
choices.risk_hint: Failure will alert the enemy, making future rescues even more difficult

text.content: Ye Qing shook her head. "With your current cultivation level, you can't even break through the outer formations. Unless you can eliminate all six guards in an instant, once the alarm is raised, the entire Holy Sect will become your enemy." Chen Ji naturally knew this, but the anxiety in his heart made it almost impossible for him to think calmly. How many years had his sister been in that dark, sunless place? How much longer could she hold on?

choices.text: Form an alliance with Ye Qing, leveraging the power of the Demonic Path
choices.description: Utilize Ye Qing's connections and resources within the Demonic Path to formulate a meticulous rescue plan
choices.visible_cost: Being indebted to Ye Qing may result in being controlled by her in the future
choices.visible_reward: Gain the support and intelligence network of the Demonic Path to improve success rate
choices.risk_hint: The involvement of the Demonic Path forces may complicate the situation

text.content: Ye Qing pondered for a moment. "I can help you. The Holy Sect is not a monolithic bloc—several elders have long been colluding with my Demonic Path. If we can find a point of entry, there might be a chance." She looked at Chen Ji, a hint of seriousness flashing in her eyes. "But I need you to promise me one thing—before taking any action, you must discuss it with me. No solo冲动."

choices.description: Return to Tianqing Sect and consult with Inner Disciple Senior Fellow Su Qingyao, leveraging the sect's power to oppose the Holy Sect
choices.visible_cost: Revealing the existence of your sister may attract the sect's covetous attention
choices.visible_reward: If Su Qingyao is willing to help, you can gain the covert support of the Tianqing Sect
choices.risk_hint: Su Qingyao has always been suspicious of you—contact may expose more vulnerabilities

text.content: Su Qingyao. That woman who has always been suspicious of him. Chen Ji weighed the pros and cons—if he could gain her trust, perhaps he could obtain support from within the Tianqing Sect. But this also meant exposing his weakness, letting her know there was someone in this world he would risk everything to save. "This matter... may be worth a try." He spoke slowly, the killing intent in his eyes gradually replaced by cold calculation.

As Chen Ji weighed his options, the Tianji Record Fragment in his embrace grew warm once more. That familiar power surged, carrying an urgent prompt. He closed his eyes and delved his consciousness into the fragment. Master Mo's aged and mysterious voice rang in his mind:

dialogue.content: "Did you find it? Your sister."
Found it. The Destiny Lock Key Hall.

"Then you should have also seen the chains on her body. Those are no ordinary chains—they are the 'Destiny Shackles'—originating from the same source as the Tianji Record. Both are creations of the ancient Heavenly Way. If you forcibly destroy them, the Lock Key will die, and the Tianji Record will collapse."

text.content: Chen Ji's heart sank heavily. He remembered the chains on his sister's wrists in the vision, the dried bloodstains—so it wasn't just imprisonment, but a kind of fated curse. If he wanted to save her, he would have to unravel the true secret of those shackles.

dialogue.content: "The password is merely the surface. The real entrance requires Heavenly Fate Value to open." Master Mo's voice carried a meaningful tone. "Each formation consumes ten points of Heavenly Fate Value. How much Heavenly Fate do you have left?"

text.content: Chen Ji unconsciously checked his condition. Heavenly Fate Value—this was his most precious resource, consumed every time he foresaw the future. Five points, ten points, fifteen points... Over the years, he had carefully accumulated and conserved them, afraid of one day running out. And now, before him lay a path of redemption paved with Heavenly Fate Value. First formation, ten points; second formation, ten points; third formation... He didn't know how many formations the Destiny Lock Key Hall had, but he knew this path was destined to be paid for with his most precious possession.

"There is one more thing." Master Mo's voice suddenly became grave. "Your sister is called the 'Destiny Lock Key' for a reason. She is one of the key nodes of this world—touching her will触动了 certain things that should not be触动了. Are you sure you want to continue?" Chen Ji did not hesitate.

dialogue.content: From the moment I became the master of the Tianji Record, I have had no path of retreat.

text.content: Master Mo was silent for a moment, then let out a soft sigh: "You are very much like that person from back then." As the words fell, the characters on the fragment began to slowly change—a string of ancient runes, emanating a faint golden glow. Chen Ji recognized a few of them—they were the passwords to enter the Destiny Lock Key Hall. "Remember this string of runes." Master Mo said, "But before using them, you need more Heavenly Fate Value. Otherwise, you won't even be able to enter the first gate." The light on the fragment gradually faded, and Chen Ji's consciousness returned to reality.

dialogue.content: Did you use the Tianji Record again?

text.content: Ye Qing's voice carried a hint of worry. Although she didn't know the specific consumption of the Tianji Record, she could see that every time he used that fragment, Chen Ji's complexion would grow several shades paler. Chen Ji did not answer, merely firmly memorizing the string of runes in his heart. Under the moonlight, his gaze became unprecedentedly sharp—that of a hunter who had been lurking in the darkness for too long, finally locking onto the scent of its prey.

「Ye Qing.」 He spoke, his voice calm yet carrying undeniable resolve, 「I need more Heavenly Fate.」 Ye Qing was slightly stunned, then understood his meaning. Heavenly Fate—the thing that determined a prophet's fate, to obtain it, how could it be easy? But looking at the light in Chen Ji's eyes, she suddenly found herself unable to refuse.

dialogue.content: The Holy Sect has been planning something major lately, if we could disrupt it...

text.content: Her words remained unfinished, yet Chen Ji had already grasped her meaning. Disrupting the Holy Sect's plan would not only weaken the enemy's strength but also create an opportunity to acquire Heavenly Fate. A two-pronged strategy—highly consistent with his style. He nodded, and beneath the moonlight, the two figures drew closer. A plan concerning revenge and redemption was taking shape. Meanwhile, in the depths of that distant Holy Sect, a figure who had been imprisoned for years suddenly opened her eyes, as if sensing something. Her lips quivered slightly, silently uttering two words—

dialogue.content: Brother...
